# CGI Virtual Property Tours

## Technical Infrastructure
DTM’s CGI Virtual Property Tours leverage 12K NeRF (Neural Radiance Fields) rendering to produce photorealistic digital environments exceeding traditional photogrammetry. Property models are LIDAR-scanned, delivering measurement accuracy up to 0.1mm. Integrated AI ruler tools calculate precise dimensions for walls, ceilings, and floors, aiding renovation and spatial planning.

## Functional Features
- **Interactive Navigation**: Hotspots are synchronized with AI-generated voiceovers in 18 languages.  
- **Dynamic Customization**: Real-time swaps of furniture, finishes, and lighting configurations through AI-powered staging modules.  
- **Financial Integration**: Embedded mortgage calculators connected to lender APIs allow live payment estimates inside the virtual environment.  
- **Multi-Platform Delivery**: Browser-based, plugin-free players maintain 60 FPS on web, mobile, and VR-ready platforms.
